verdict.rationale: LangGraph's own Agent Server runtime publishes Crons and Runs endpoints in its OpenAPI spec, which points to recurring scheduled runs. Its durable-execution features also let agents run for extended periods and resume automatically. However, scheduling and background execution appear only as endpoint-group names and marketing lines, with no documented setup flow. missing for 10: documentation on creating and managing cron schedules, explicit background/async run semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration of autonomous scheduled automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Threads, Thread Runs, Stateless Runs, Crons, Store, A2A, MCP, and System endpoints
Build agents that persist through failures and can run for extended periods, automatically resuming from exactly where they left off.
The resulting server exposes all API endpoints for runs, threads, assistants, etc.
LangGraph is a low-level orchestration framework for building, managing, and deploying long-running, stateful agents.
